talk.transcript: Today, I want to discuss the concept of sustainability in urban planning. Sustainability refers to designing urban environments that meet the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. This involves integrating green spaces, utilizing renewable resources, and promoting public transport to reduce carbon footprints. Cities can implement policies that encourage sustainable practices, such as energy-efficient buildings and waste reduction programs. By focusing on sustainability, urban planners can create healthier and more livable communities that thrive economically and environmentally.

questions.q: What does sustainability in urban planning aim to do?
questions.explain: 城市規劃中的可持續性旨在滿足當前和未來的需求。

questions.q: What is one outcome of focusing on sustainability?
questions.explain: 專注於可持續性的一個結果是更健康的社區。
